game: DAL @ NYJ, 2025-10-05 13:00 ET, NYJ -1.5, total 48.5, outdoors, weather not saved

script.base: Competitive outdoor game, Jets a 1.5-point home favorite, implied totals NYJ 25.0 and DAL 23.5. A 48.5 total means more plays, not a slog, and a 1.5 spread is not a blowout so starters should play this out. Dallas, without CeeDee Lamb (11 targets, 112 yards in weeks 2-4) and KaVontae Turpin (11 targets, 141 yards, 141 air), concentrates throws on Jake Ferguson (already 33 targets) and George Pickens. Jets offense is Garrett Wilson plus Justin Fields as a real runner (12 carries, 130 yards in those three weeks) and Breece Hall as the lead back on only 11 carries a game.
script.flip1: Jets score first and lead late: Dallas abandons Javonte Williams (48 carries, 258 yards in weeks 2-4), so his rush line dies and Ferguson/Pickens volume spikes, while Fields and Hall salt the clock and Wilson's targets cool.
script.flip2: Dallas leads: Williams carries climb behind a battered line, Jets fall behind and throw more to Wilson and Hall, Hall's rush share dies, and Fields' designed runs become scramble-only.

pre_mortem: It is Monday and Ferguson under 59.5 lost the over: the Jets' middle, 5.35 YPA on 17 throws, sat on the seams, Jermaine Johnson played, and the Guyton/Booker replacements never let Prescott get to the checkdown. Vacated Turpin air yards (141) went to Pickens on two explosives, Ferguson finished in the 23-40 band he already showed twice in four games, and Carter II's absence did not matter because a TE was not his man. That counter is real but thinner than the stacked funnel (target leader, two WRs out, OL forcing the short game, slot CB out, 66.7 vs 59.5), so the lean stays and is flagged, not sized.
